description: Provision a MySQL database for a specific instance (by id or exact name), generating its hostname, database name, username and password. Many plugins use MySQL instead of flat files for performance. Fails if the server already has one, so call get_database_info first to check.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be created (a new MySQL database and credentials will be provisioned for this server) and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: create_database
title: Create Database
